inputs.text: This war in Iran is dragging on as another brutal example of how militaristic policies rooted in historical power imbalances and institutional biases keep exploiting the most vulnerable. Energy prices are spiking and slamming working families along with the poorest communities hardest, flights are grounded, and our screens are flooded with nonstop death and destruction. Bloomberg is pointing out the global outcry demanding an end to this poorly planned, unwinnable conflict that's endangering well-being for everyone. Yet the public in Israel stays firmly behind pushing it forward with no clear end in sight. This stark divide makes it obvious that these kinds of aggressions sacrifice marginalized populations worldwide while shielding the privileged from the full human and economic costs.

output.main_topic: The human and economic impacts of the war in Iran and the divide between global opposition and public support in Israel
subtopics: Rising energy prices and effects on working families and poor communities
Grounded flights and exposure to death and destruction
Global outcry demanding an end to the conflict
Public support in Israel for continuing the conflict
